text: CI matrix built in 2ab52e8 (.github/workflows/ci.yml), with the consumer-scope fix in 4eb566d. Three jobs. 'test' is a matrix of Scala 3.3.8 (LTS, the published line) and 3.9.0 (current feature release) against JDK 17 and 21, running testAll, which names all thirteen modules explicitly -- so a passing cell has compiled every backend and run its unit, law, conformance, differential, fuzz, golden and performance-gate suites on the JVM and Scala.js. 'style' runs scalafmtCheckAll and tools/check-docs.sh once, since neither varies by cell. 'compatibility' runs the exact-baseline gate once on the published line. Acceptance met on all three criteria. Reaching the matrix took two source changes: crossScalaVersions in commonSettings with the default moved from 3.4.2 to the LTS (TASTy is forward- but not backward-compatible, so an LTS build is readable by every later 3.x consumer), and ContinuousScale.train rewritten to bind a pair rather than destructure it, the one place Scala 3.3 refuses an irrefutable for-comprehension pattern that 3.4 allows. Documentation examples and links are checked by tools/check-docs.sh: mdoc compiles every fenced 'mdoc' block in docs/ against the real modules (48 documents, 136 checked fences), the gallery re-renders and must match its committed SVGs, and tools/check-links.sh resolves every relative link and heading anchor repository-wide. External URLs are checked by a separate weekly workflow (.github/workflows/docs-links.yml) rather than in CI, because reaching third-party hosts would make a merge depend on someone else's uptime. Evidence: both matrix Scala lines pass locally with identical counts (coreJVM 381, coreJS 376, lawsJVM 32, lawsJS 32, svgJVM 53, svgJS 49, notebookJVM 5, performanceJVM 3, performanceJS 2, canvasJS 19, java2dJVM 26, pdfJVM 9, javafxJVM 12). Not established: the workflow has never executed on GitHub, and JDK 17 and 21 were not exercised locally -- only the sbt commands each cell runs. Local sbt ran on JDK 25.
